title: Colchicine after Electrocardioversion for Atrial Fibrillation - The COLECTRO-AF Trial
official: Colchicine after Electrocardioversion for Atrial Fibrillation - The COLECTRO-AF Trial
summary: Main objective: Documented atrial fibrillation recurrences within 6 months after ECV in patients with atrial fibrillation.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age >18 years
2. Scheduled for ECV
3. ECG-documented AF prior to ECV
4. Successful ECV with conversion of AF to sinus rhythm with persistent sinus rhythm ≥1 hour after ECV
5. Ability and provision of written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. AF persistence after cardioversion or early AF recurrence within 1 hour after ECV
2. Any absolute indication for Colchicine intake
3. Intake of a strong inhibitor of CYP3A4 or P-Glycoprotein
4. Serious gastrointestinal disease
5. Clinically overt hepatic disease
6. Severe renal disease
7. Men actively attempting to father children
8. Any other contraindication for Colchicine intake
9. Galactose intolerance, total lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption
10. Clinically significant blood dyscrasia
11. Significant immunosuppression
12. Pregnant or breastfeeding womenwomen, or women of child-bearing potential who do not use a highly effective form of birth control during and 3 months following Colchicine treatment
13. Life expectancy <1 year
14. Prior enrolment in the COLECTRO-AF trial
15. Any other rhythm than AF prior to ECV
16. Pulmonary vein isolation within 3 months prior to ECV or pulmonary vein isolation planned in the next 3 months
17. Known intolerance or hypersensitivity to Colchicine
